data.value: Achievement dates, your own minigame score outside the top 30, mission counters, the units setting and your reserve licences.

data.name: Tip_Slow
data.value: Can take a long time. You are asked to confirm before the backup starts.

data.name: Slow_kills
data.value: One request for each hunt, each scored kill and each kill picture: many requests.

data.name: Slow_photos
data.value: Large downloads, one request for each picture.

data.name: Slow_history
data.value: Hundreds of requests, tens of KB each; about half an hour.

data.name: Slow_older
data.value: Estimate: up to 7,000 more requests, 2 hours or more.

data.name: Slow_Title
data.value: This backup can take a long time

data.name: Slow_Intro
data.value: You ticked options that need many requests. The tool sends at most one request per second to each server, so the backup can take a long time:

data.name: Slow_Outro
data.value: The progress line shows the time left. You can cancel at any time: what is saved stays, and a later run with "Skip files already saved (resume)" continues from there.

data.name: How_1a
data.value: The tool asks the official servers for your profile and saves what they answer, unchanged, in a folder on this PC. It never changes anything on the server.

data.name: How_1b
data.value: One exception: Messages, which is off unless you tick it. Opening an unread conversation can mark it as read, and nothing can undo that.

data.name: How_2a
data.value: It connects only to the official servers listed in settings.json, next to backup.exe. You can open that file in a text editor.

data.name: How_2b
data.value: Your backup stays on this PC. Upload to a server is not available yet.

data.name: How_3a
data.value: To read your own account it uses the session of the running game. It never writes that session to a file, and sends it only to the official server.

data.name: How_3b
data.value: A public profile needs no sign-in: only public data is saved.

data.name: How_3c
data.value: It runs on this PC and needs no installation and no administrator rights.

data.name: How_4a
data.value: The backup folder you choose, and a zip of it unless you turn "Save a zip" off. A small key file, claim.key, is kept in %APPDATA%\game-backup and copied into every backup.

data.name: How_4b
data.value: Keep the zip private: it holds your account's data, your Steam id (with "My account") and claim.key.

data.name: How_5a
data.value: A backup is your profile as it was while the backup ran. Anything you play, earn, buy or change in the game afterwards is not in it.

data.name: How_5b
data.value: To bring it up to date, run another backup: it goes into a new folder with the date and time in its name, and the first one stays as it was. "Skip files already saved" does not do that: it only continues a backup that did not finish.

data.name: Msg_Finished
data.value: Backup finished {0:g}. Anything you play, earn, buy or change in the game after that is not in it: run a new backup.
